acceptance_receipt.formal_scope: Fourteen canonical rational conversion results, followed by eighteen public-unit and twenty-three extended-unit/getter policy results in research modules. The extended model proves the exact classification change and conditional current-factor/value preservation under a supplied successful Style-provider contract. Counts describe separate scopes, not whole-CSS coverage or new canonical registration.
acceptance_receipt.discovery: Native source analysis and calibrated browser reproduction preceded the policy proofs. Lean validates conditional invariants and witnesses; this was not automatic end-to-end native bug discovery.
acceptance_receipt.independence: Both phases remove all30 pending native overlays to HEAD90; candidate changes only DOMSVGLength.cpp and DOMSVGLength.h. Fix115 and other pending patches are absent. No pristine-upstream runtime claim.
acceptance_receipt.limits: Validated ordinary visible percentage, em and parsed viewport-unit reads/conversions. Hidden-subtree provider completion, unsafe/initial/detached documents, arbitrary fonts, reentrancy/lifetime, IEEE arithmetic, cross-platform behavior and performance remain outside this evidence.
acceptance_receipt.triage: Ordinary-size SVG API value correctness; no security or performance impact established.
